dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: This place is so quiet! It's a perfect place to brush up on my legal research and organize my notes.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, do you still remember those clauses I discussed with you once before?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You've already forgotten? Well, you'll just have to recite them over and over until you know them by heart.
